rules.name: Known Threat File Hash Match
rules.description: Detects executable files or processes matching known threat hash signatures.
rules.explanation: File hash matched a threat intelligence indicator of compromise.

rules.name: Suspicious LOLBin Command Line Execution
rules.description: Detects Living-off-the-Land binaries launched with encoded or download command line flags.
rules.explanation: A standard system binary was invoked with arguments typical of stagers or payload downloads.

rules.name: Suspicious Parent-Child Process Relationship
rules.description: Identifies document applications or web servers directly spawning interactive shells or interpreters.
rules.explanation: Interactive shell spawned by an office application or web server, indicative of macro or exploit execution.

rules.name: Execution from Temporary Directory
rules.description: Detects processes running from world-writable or user temporary directories.
rules.explanation: Binaries executing from temporary storage locations often indicate dropped malware or initial payloads.

rules.name: Suspicious Remote IP Address Connection
rules.description: Detects outbound network sockets connecting to known suspicious IP addresses.
rules.explanation: Outbound socket connection established to an address listed in known suspicious network indicators.

rules.name: Failed Logon Anomaly
rules.description: Detects Windows Event 4625 (Failed Logon) or Linux authentication failures.
rules.explanation: Authentication failure event captured, potentially representing brute-force or unauthorized logon attempts.
